label: BDP306
source: doi: 10.1093/nar/gkaf511, additional data provided by Zimo Jin; GenBank file '1.2 BDP306.gb' supplied by the user (754 bp). Stored as in the file (5' end on the left, the GAL1-10 orientation: the right end faces the nanocompartment module).
notes: Bidirectional promoter. Checked: only A/C/G/T, no BsaI/BbsI site. Contains a PstI site (CTGCAG), which RFC 10 forbids in a part; it does not affect the Golden Gate assembly. The direction in which the two sides drive the modules still has to be checked against the lab.
